jobs.title: Risk Underwriter / Credit Analyst – Middle East
jobs.description:
**Atradius**

The Atradius Group provides trade credit insurance, surety and collections services worldwide, and has a presence through 160 offices in 52 countries. The products offered by Atradius protect companies around the world against the default risks associated with selling goods and services on credit.

At Atradius, we believe in personal development and the Growth Mindset. Our Culture is based on teamwork, reliable accountability, constantly improving and unrivalled service. Read on more on our Career site: https://careers.atradius.com/en/careers.

**Job Description**
  
Atradius Trade Credit (Re)insurance (DIFC) Ltd. is looking for an experienced and self-motivated **Risk Underwriter / Credit Analyst** to join our Risk Services team, based in either **Dubai or Riyadh**.

This is an opportunity to join an international and dynamic business, working across a diverse portfolio of companies and industries in the Middle East. The role combines in-depth credit risk analysis with active portfolio management and close interaction with customers, brokers and other stakeholders.

The successful candidate will have strong analytical and commercial judgement, sound financial analysis skills and the ability to assess complex credit risks and translate this into clear underwriting decisions and strategies.  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Analyse the credit risk of **SMEs, large corporates, listed companies and complex groups** across the Middle East.
* Underwrite credit limit applications and make sound risk decisions within delegated authorities.
* Set and maintain appropriate **buyer, group, sector and portfolio underwriting strategies**.
* Perform detailed financial analysis, including assessment of financial performance, liquidity, leverage, cash flow and overall creditworthiness.
* Identify emerging risks and proactively manage exposures based on developments at **buyer, sector, country and portfolio level**.
* Regularly review existing exposures and adjust underwriting strategies where appropriate.
* Set and maintain appropriate buyer ratings/risk assessments in line with internal guidelines.
* Ensure underwriting decisions are clearly documented, justified and compliant with internal policies and procedures.
* Monitor economic, sector and market developments and assess their potential impact on insured risks and portfolio performance.
* Work closely with customers, brokers, buyers and internal stakeholders to understand risks and support appropriate underwriting solutions.
* Conduct buyer meetings and engage with company management where additional insight is required.
* Prepare and present complex or significant cases to the relevant credit committees.
* Contribute to the development and sharing of market, sector and risk knowledge within the wider Risk Services organisation.
* Support and share knowledge with other members of the underwriting team.

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or above, preferably in **Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration or a related discipline**.
* Typically **5+ years of relevant experience** in credit risk, underwriting, banking, financial analysis or a related field, with trade credit insurance experience considered an advantage.
* Strong financial analysis and credit assessment skills, including the ability to analyse complex corporate and group structures.
* Good understanding of the **Middle East business environment, key industries and regional risk dynamics**.
* Strong analytical judgement with the ability to make and clearly support independent credit decisions.
* Ability to identify material risks while maintaining a commercial and customer-focused approach.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to discuss and explain complex credit decisions clearly.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a regional and international team.
* Strong written and spoken English; **Arabic would be an advantage**.
* Willingness to travel within the region as required.

**For position employed and based in Saudi Arabia, the employment relationship will be with Fronter on behalf of Atradius DIFC.**

**What do we offer?**

* A dynamic, international and challenging work environment
* Exposure to a diverse range of companies, sectors and markets across the Middle East.
* The opportunity to work within an experienced regional and international Risk Services network.
* Continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
* Challenging and varied responsibilities with scope for continued career development.
* Competitive remuneration and benefits in line with the relevant local market.

  

**Equal opportunities for all**

The success of our organisation stands with the quality of our people and the ideas they have. Insights and innovative solutions for our customers are the result of an interplay of cultures, knowledge and experience. That is why diversity is extremely important to Atradius. To ensure that all colleagues within Atradius can develop their qualities, we promote an inclusive culture in which everyone feels involved and valued. We encourage and welcome everyone to apply to our positions.

**I am Atradius! - Do you want to know who we are?**
  
Get to know Atradius colleagues in this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NnsgT04OpTU&t=4s
  
  
*Atradius is a global provider of credit insurance, bond and surety, collections and information services, with a strategic presence in over 50 countries. The products offered by Atradius protect companies around the world against the default risks associated with selling goods and services on credit. Atradius is a member of Grupo Catalana Occidente (GCO.MC), one of the largest insurers in Spain and one of the largest credit insurers in the world.*
  
*You can find further information on our website:* *https://group.atradius.com*

jobs.title: Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Job Description: To provide support and advice to the management team on financial performance matters and assist in creating and implementing forecasting / budgeting tools and strategies that provide key stakeholders with relevant, accurate and timely management information which supports executive level decision making.

  

Responsibilities: Provide timely, relevant, and accurate reports and analysis of performance against historical, budgeted, and forecasted results to facilitate decision-making toward the achievement of the budget and strategic plan  
Provision of business analysis and KPI management  
Adopting a business partnering approach and providing essential financial advice and support to key stakeholders  
Ensure business growth objectives are achieved through planning, coordination and production of budgets and forecasts in a timely manner  
Maintain and develop financial models to aid planning processes, ensuring quality, accuracy, and focused analytical review  
Manage the successful delivery of process improvement initiatives by identifying non-value add activities and implementing solutions which create operational efficiencies across the business  
Responsible for the preparation and execution of month end reporting tasks, ensuring the necessary information is provided in an accurate and timely manner i.e. MIS reporting  
Support the interim and year end audit process, liaising with external auditors and preparing and consolidating relevant information as required in a timely manner  
Preparation of periodic reports for OEM requirements and compliance  
Ensure processes and procedures are fully documented in a clear and concise manner and always maintained  
Support in the preparation of board presentations for management  
Preparation of ad hoc reports and analysis as required by management  
Participate in the automation of processes and system implementation for Finance as a key project member (i.e. ERP, BI Tool)  
Managing adhoc reports for OEM’s and internal stakeholders  
* Work closely with the accounting team to ensure accurate financial reporting

  

Qualifications: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance  
Professional accounting qualification i.e. CMA, CIMA, ACCA, CPA, CA  
4-5 years post qualification experience in a fast paced multinational organization  
  
Previous experience in an analytical role advantageous  
  
Knowledge & Capabilities:  
  
Excellent MS Office software proficiency: strong Excel skills required  
Thorough understanding of International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS)  
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail – financial modelling experience an advantage  
Independent worker and analytical thinker with the ability to conduct research, data analysis and resolve complex problems  
Ability to multi-task and work in a challenging fast paced environment  
Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to work confidently under pressure  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
* Strong work ethic, passionate and committed with an enthusiasm to drive change.
